audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and used the fabricated passive name 'Iron Boundary' (real: Void Shift); tradeGood described poking a shield off TF, who has no shield; the auto-reset tell on Pick a Card (from missingInteractions) was absent.
audit.why: Key interactions: Pick a Card is a 6s-cooldown auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back; gold card stun breaks Void Shift's window and starts every gank; Destiny (170/140/110) vs Nether Grasp (140/110/80) means you out-tempo his roams; his kit has no escape from suppression.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, tradeGood and dependents rewritten with real numbers and the reset tell.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget spell shield (Iron Boundary) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Pick a Card: 6s cooldown and an auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back when it glows gold. - Destiny runs 170s at rank 1 against your Nether Grasp's 140/110/80 — you out-tempo his roams. - Budget Void Shift for the stun, the R for greed.
